summary: Auth compatibility with installs of the earlier library entry, read-only (Greptile PR #2450 round 2 P1; orchestrator decision after Codex novel1219-r7: no migration, no file writes). Env: CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_API_KEY, a legacy name with one deprecation line on stderr. Saved keys: bearer_auth / api_key are extra field names of the same documents the CLI already loads: cliutil.Credentials carries them (LegacyBearerAuth / LegacyAPIKey), the existing checked-descriptor loader parses them from the same bytes, HasValues counts them (so an unsafe or aliased file is a present refusal that suppresses the global fallback exactly as for crm_bearer_auth), ApplyLegacyKeys fills the bearer only when the document has no crm_bearer_auth (bearer_auth before api_key), and credentialsFileFrom never writes them; the config file's are read inside parseConfigData over cliutil.ReadOpenedConfig's bytes. Nothing is rewritten; one notice names the file and 'conduyt-crm-pp-cli auth set-token'. No secret value is printed. cliutil/credentials.go is generator-owned: this patch must be re-applied on a reprint.
reason: The 4.34.2 reprint reads only CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and crm_bearer_auth; existing installs that use the earlier env names or saved keys would lose authentication on upgrade.
validated_outcome: TestLegacyAuthEnvPrecedence, TestLegacyAuthConfigKeysReadInPlace, TestLegacyAuthCredentialsFilesReadInPlace (profile first; global with matching / other origin), TestLegacyAuthUnsafeProfileFileSuppressesGlobalFallback, TestLegacyAuthMixedDocumentKeepsFieldPrecedence, TestLegacyAuthTrustOutcomesMatchTheCurrentKey (loose mode, symlinked profile data directory, owner-only: legacy keys get the current key's outcome; legacy_auth.go has no file I/O), TestLegacyAuthUntrustedConfigFileIsRefused and TestLegacyAuthSavesNeverWriteLegacyKeys pass, every file unchanged and no secret in any output; the FULL live gate passes with CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and with only CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH.
